01 / The Game

Death is only
the beginning.

Spright is a fast, atmospheric action-platformer built around responsive movement, punishing encounters, and worlds that refuse to stay buried.

Dash through sealed ruins. Crack open Spirit Gates. Hunt blueprints. Face towering creatures and learn their patterns before they break you.

Move fast.
Strike first.

01

Fight

Master close-range weapons, deflect attacks, and turn enemy pressure into your opening.

Cross burning foundries, drowned trenches, ruined halls, and the cold reaches of space.

Claim crowns and blueprints to shape your build and survive what waits below.
